quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech IR presentation: YTD September 2026 sales (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 sales presentation, upcoming regulatory decisions and launches: giredestrant US approvals expected in Q4 (PDUFA 30th Nov in adjuvant HR+ breast cancer and 18th Dec in post-CDKi HR+ mBC); Gazyva in membranous nephropathy (PDUFA 15th Nov) and in SLE (PDUFA 4th Dec); Enspryng in MOGAD (US filing with priority review, PDUFA set for 10th Jan; EU filing achieved); vamikibart in UME (PDUFA set for 23rd Jul; EU filing achieved); fenebrutinib in RMS/PPMS filed in the US with priority review granted using a priority review voucher. Potential launches by year-end 2027: divarasib in 2L NSCLC, vamikibart in UME, Enspryng in MOGAD and TED, sefaxersen in IgAN and afimkibart in UC. 2027 regulatory newsflow includes US/EU approval of divarasib (2L KRAS G12C+ NSCLC), the Hemlibra autoinjector and PiaSky in aHUS, US approval of fenebrutinib in RMS and PPMS, and a US filing for sefaxersen.
quarterly_data.figure: PDUFA dates: Gazyva MN 15 Nov, giredestrant 30 Nov and 18 Dec, Gazyva SLE 4 Dec, Enspryng MOGAD 10 Jan, vamikibart 23 Jul

quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech IR presentation: YTD September 2026 sales (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 sales presentation, pipeline: Roche targets up to 20 NMEs with launch potential by 2030, with two recent additions, Tam-Peli in SCLC and NSCLC and the VEGF x IL6 DutaFab in DME (moving to Ph III); it reports 7 positive Ph III readouts year to date and a YTD Phase III success rate exceeding 80%, while giredestrant's persevERA (1L HR+/HER2- mBC) and the emugrobart Ph II studies MANATEE, MANOEUVRE and GYMINDA did not succeed (page 12 and page 37 figures); emugrobart was removed from phase II. The clinical pipeline went from 81 NMEs (Q2 '23) to 60 (YTD Sep '26). Six platform discovery deals have been signed since HY 2026 (pending deal closure) plus the Hanmi UCN2 analog (HM17321) and Rona ALK7-targeting RNAi obesity partnerships (page 13 figure). Obesity: petrelintide Ph III (ZUPREME-3/4/5) initiated and the ZYNERGY enicepatide + petrelintide combination study to start in Q4; tifeglipron (CT-996) Ph III (MetORA) to start in H1 2027; enicepatide Ph III expanding to glycemic control in T2D including head-to-head versus tirzepatide, HFrEF and a CVOT; Roche states an ambition to become a top 3 player in obesity. Trontinemab Ph III (PrevenTRON) in preclinical Alzheimer's disease was initiated; Ocrevus OBI data are expected in 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 20 NMEs by 2030; 7 positive Ph III readouts YTD; YTD Ph III success rate >80%; pipeline 60 NMEs

quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech IR presentation: YTD September 2026 sales (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 sales presentation, commercial KPIs and outlook detail: LOE impact of roughly CHF 0.6bn expected for 2026; assuming 30 September 2026 exchange rates, the full-year currency impact is expected at -3%p on sales and -5%p on core operating profit and core EPS (Q4 sales +4%p). Phesgo global conversion rate climbing to 59% (86 launch countries); ~56,000 patients on Ocrevus SC globally, with SC above 20% of total Ocrevus volume and ~60% of US SC volume from community practices; Evrysdi >27,000 patients treated; Xolair food allergy >145,000 patients treated since launch, with the first US Xolair biosimilar launched; Gazyva lupus nephritis ~5,000 patients treated since launch; Vabysmo ~1.5m patients treated globally and >60% of US patient starts naive. Hemlibra and Alecensa: high single digit and low single digit growth expected for FY respectively. Diagnostics: AXELIOS 1 (launched June 2026) has reached ~1/3 of its Year 1 order target of 100 instruments, and Roche and Twist Bioscience are collaborating on a target enrichment solution for AXELIOS; cobas HDV received the CE mark. Pharma AI: 85k employees trained, 80+ use cases, and Roche is deploying an AI Factory with >3,500 Blackwell GPUs; Lab-in-the-Loop drove +155% lead identification Go, +75% lead optimization Go and +50% internal development Go over 2022-2025.
quarterly_data.figure: LOE ~CHF 0.6bn; FY FX -3%p sales, -5%p core EPS; AXELIOS ~1/3 of 100-instrument target; >3,500 Blackwell GPUs
